sources.name: GitHub issues of date-fns/date-fns
sources.version: GitHub REST API 2022-11-28, state as of 2026-11-11
sources.license: GitHub Terms of Service (user content; only facts and our own summaries are kept)

provenance.notes: URL, number, title, state, dates, counts and labels are copied from the API response of each issue. Category, components, summary, resolution and lesson are written by the researcher (tools/extract/field-reports/curation) after reading the issue body returned by the search API and, for the issues listed in docs/research/field-reports.md, the full thread. daysOpen of an open issue is measured to the retrieval date. fixedBy is filled mechanically from merged pull requests that name the issue after a closing keyword. Reports marked needs-review state a cause that the researcher inferred from the symptom without a confirming statement in the issue.

reports.title: Jalali Calendar
reports.summary: A request for the Jalali calendar, open since 2018 with a help-wanted label; the library is Gregorian-only and other calendars live in forks.
reports.lesson: Calendar systems are a dimension of our date core, not a fork per calendar: Gregorian, Umm al-Qura, tabular Islamic and Persian share one API.

reports.title: Hijri calendar
reports.summary: A request for a Hijri calendar, noting that the older moment ecosystem had one; it was closed after twenty months as a support question, without the feature.
reports.lesson: Hijri (Umm al-Qura) dates are in the core with authoritative month-length data.

reports.title: Can't parse arabic localized dates
reports.summary: Arabic localised date strings copied from a real web page could not be parsed; the strings contain an invisible directional override character, which the reporter could not even paste into the issue. Open for more than six years.
reports.lesson: Parsers strip or ignore bidi control characters (U+200E/F, U+202A–E, U+2066–9, U+061C) and accept both the Arabic comma and Arabic-Indic digits; fixture strings include each control character.

reports.title: Change dates to local numerals
reports.summary: Month and weekday names were localised for Arabic, but day and year numbers were always Latin digits, with no option for locale numerals. Open for more than five years.
reports.lesson: The numbering system is an explicit formatting option with a locale default (arab for ar-SA/ar-EG contexts where chosen, latn for ar-AE/Maghreb), applied to every numeric field.

reports.title: `ar` locale is missing
reports.summary: A generic Arabic locale was referenced but commented out, so only Algerian, Moroccan and Saudi variants existed, and users asked for Modern Standard Arabic. It took nine months.
reports.lesson: A base ar locale always exists; regional variants extend it.

reports.title: Allow diff digits numerals based on locale
reports.summary: A second request to let locales output numerals other than Latin digits, open for five years with no decision.
reports.lesson: As above; digit substitution is done in the formatter, never by post-processing the output string.

reports.title: Arabic time format is incorrect
reports.summary: The time format patterns of the Arabic locale differ from the CLDR patterns for Arabic. Open for more than three years with no response.
reports.lesson: Format patterns are generated from CLDR for each locale and never hand-maintained; a test compares our output with Intl for a fixed set of dates.
